From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: camila_reyes@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai
Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@orchidhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Nov 2029 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated onboarding — autoscale sim results

Folks — I ran three sims (baseline, priming-enabled, high-churn) against Alex's forecast. Summary attached; highlights below.

Summary highlights:
- Baseline (minimal KV priming): p50 concurrency 18, p90 concurrency 42 during peak hour. Cold-start penalty ~600ms median token-latency for first 30s of a spike.
- Priming (prefix caching + warm KV): p50 concurrency 22, p90 35; cold-start penalty drops to ~180ms. Operational cost increases ~8% over baseline committed-hours but reduces on-demand burst usage.
- High-churn (heavy short-lived sessions): bursts lead to 3x on-demand usage spikes; recommend a burst-cap policy capped at 1.5x committed capacity with guarded autoscale cooldowns to prevent runaway spend.

Recommendation for residency:
- Us-west primary (CA traffic) with an always-warm min replica set sized to p50+10% buffer.
- Us-east warm-standby routed for NY/NE; cross-region routing only for sustained spikes > 5 minutes to avoid repeated cold starts.

Attachments: autoscale-sim-results-20291108.csv (simulation dump), sim-brief-20291108.pdf

Let me know if you want me to tune the cooldown windows or model a larger committed footprint.

-Markus
Head of Capacity Engineering, Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@orchidhealth.com>, camila_reyes@redwood.ai, monica_patel@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 10 Nov 2029 16:47:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Dedicated onboarding — commercial mapping for committed tiers

Alex / Procurement — attaching a short commercial sketch for three commit tiers (Small / Medium / Large) and an example charge flow when burst triggers. Callouts:

- Small (250 committed GPU hours/mo): targets pilot traffic; burst capped at 1.25x; estimated monthly cost $12,800 (includes 10% buffer).
- Medium (1,000 committed GPU hours/mo): expected GA traffic; burst capped at 1.5x; estimated monthly cost $44,000.
- Large (3,000 committed GPU hours/mo): heavy production; burst capped at 2x with additional governance and alerts; estimated monthly cost $120,500.

Notes on billing during cross-region bursts:
- Bursts served from warm-standby incur regional egress and cross-region pricing; we show those as separate line items in the table.
- For procurement ease, we can offer a 60-day lookback cap that caps effective burst charges to no more than 20% above committed monthly spend for the first 3 months. This is a contract-level concession we can include in the SOW draft.

Next steps:
1) Alex — confirm which commit tier you want us to model in the SOW draft.
2) Procurement — once tier selected, we’ll produce a 1-page SOW commercial appendix and a DocuSign envelope for signature.

Attachments: sow-draft-redwood-v1.pdf

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
